description: Invoke any BlackOps catalog tool that is not on the default surface, by name. Arguments are validated against the same schema the tool has natively, and the call runs the identical handler with identical permissions — this is dispatch, not a bypass. Look up names and input schemas with describe_tools first.

args.description: The tool's arguments, matching the input_schema from describe_tools.

name.description: Catalog tool name, exactly as returned by describe_tools.

name: use_tool
title: Use Tool
